note: 只看不採的圖鑑項目（collectible: false），由觀察點或任務旗標記錄。

items.description: 夏天夜裡過馬路的陸蟹。
items.descriptionEn: Land crabs crossing the road on summer nights.
items.codex: 陸蟹在夏夜下海釋放幼生。開車騎車放慢，不抓、不擋路，數一數就好。
items.codexEn: On summer nights, land crabs go down to the sea to release their young. Slow down on the road, don't catch them or block their way — just count them.

items.description: 夜間潮間帶背著殼走路的寄居蟹。
items.descriptionEn: Hermit crabs carrying their shells across the tide flats at night.
items.codex: 寄居蟹需要合適的殼才能長大，不要把殼帶走當紀念品。
items.codexEn: Hermit crabs need the right shells to grow. Don't take shells home as souvenirs.

items.description: 夜裡在路邊樹林叫的蘭嶼角鴞。
items.descriptionEn: The Lanyu scops owl calling in the roadside woods at night.
items.codex: 蘭嶼特有的小型貓頭鷹。觀察時不打閃光、不放錄音引牠。族人對貓頭鷹有自己的看法，請尊重。
items.codexEn: A small owl found only on Lanyu. When watching, no flash and no recorded calls to lure it. The Tao people have their own views on owls — please respect them.

items.descriptionEn: Goats on the slopes of Imorod.
items.codex: 島上的羊是各家養的，耳朵上的記號代表是哪一家。不是自己家的不要碰。
items.codexEn: The island's goats belong to families. The mark on the ear shows which family. Don't touch goats that aren't yours.
